description:
Organic Kamut Flour (Non-GMO, Bulk)

What Is Kamut Flour Made From?

Organic kamut flour is made from kamut, also known as Khorasan wheat. For centuries it has been consigned to history, but not it made a return. As people look for more nutritious alternatives to staple products, organic kamut flour gains more prominence. It certainly is more beneficial because of its sweet, nutty taste and a higher nutrient content.

Organic kamut grain is very similar to regular wheat, although its seeds are larger. It’s an actual ancestor of wheat but it was forgotten for a very long time. An American airman is responsible for its return to the market. In 1949, when he was in Egypt, he mailed these grains to his family in Montana. The legend has it that he picked up the seeds found in a tomb of an ancient pharaoh.

The Egyptians buried their kings with everything they might need in the afterlife, including the best foods available. The seeds were waiting in the tomb for millennia until they got to grow again.

Of course, that might just be a romanticized version of the actual story. However, the truth is that today, every American can enjoy Organic Kamut Flour from Food To Live. Today this grain remains quite rare. It’s mainly cultivated in Europe. It’s also grown in Montana, US and the seeds even made their way to Australia.

Food To Live Ground Organic Kamut Flour for You

Food To Live Organic Kamut Flour is a product relentlessly tested for quality. The Food To Live facility and procedures comply with the strict USDA guidelines for organic food manufacturers. Both are inspected regularly to ensure the quality of all our products.

How to prepare Cachapas

– 1 cup P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix
– 1 ¼ cups water
– ¼ cup milk
– 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
– Shortening or vegetable oil to grease the pan

PREPARATION

1. Pour water, milk and oil into a bowl. Slowly add P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix and stir until homogeneous. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
2. Pour a portion of the batter with a ladle on a greased hot pan or griddle and spread it to make 5-6 inch wide discs.
3. Cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
4. Side with butter and fresh white cheese, or any other filling of your choice.

description:
Open yourself up to a whole new world of grain-free possibilities: SHILOH FARMS Organic Cassava Flour so closely mimics traditional wheat-based flours, you'd swear you were using the "real" thing!

Paleo-friendly and highly digestible, cassava flour is a wonderful non-allergenic option for those who cannot tolerate coconut- or nut-based flours in their grain-free baking. Exceptionally versatile and easy-to-use, it's neutral flavor and fine texture make it a welcome addition to just about any recipe!

Although closely related to tapioca flour, the two are distinctly different. To produce tapioca flour, the starch is extracted from cassava root before being bleached, dried, and milled. In contrast, cassava flour is made from the whole peeled root. Distinctions also exist in their uses: while tapioca functions best as a thickener or in flour blends, cassava behaves in many ways like a traditional flour and can even be substituted cup-for-cup in many recipes.

Flourishing in sub-optimal conditions and requiring relatively little energy to produce, cassava (also know as yuca) is a highly sustainable crop. Because of this, this starchy root vegetable is a primary source of nutrients in many parts of the world. In fact, in its various forms, cassava accounts for up to 30% of the total daily calories consumed in parts of Africa!

Usage: Cassava flour can be substituted for up to 100% of the total flour in many recipes. For certain recipes requiring a rise (such as yeast breads), 25%-50% of the total flour can be substituted with cassava.

Suggestions:
1. Make grain-free cookies, brownies, muffins, and other baked goods.
2. Its neutral flavor makes it a great choice for grain-free breads, biscuits, and pizza dough.
3. Add to pancake, crepe, or tempura batters.
4. Thicken soups, stews, gravies, or sauces.
5. Use as a binder in meatloaf or burgers.

description:
Delicious arepas can now be your specialty! Harina P.A.N. is one of the most popular brands of corn flour. Versatile and perfect for a wide range of
dishes such as arepas, empanadas, cornbread, bollos, hallacas, pupusas, tamales to mention just a few.

P.A.N. pre-cooked corn meal is a unique product made out of pure corn. Gluten-free and does not contain any preservatives, artificial colors or flavorings.
The production process is chemical free. Just by adding water, P.A.N. makes instant corn dough, creating a variety of delicious and easy corn based dishes
that can be adapted to different tastes and customs.

How to Prepare the Dough
Preparing the dough is an easy process:
– Pour 2 ½ cups of water into a container.
– Add salt and gradually mix in 2 ½ cups of corn meal.
– Briefly knead the mixture until a smooth dough is formed and then let it rest for 3 minutes.

How to Prepare Arepas
Separate dough in 10 pieces. Take one portion in your hands and shape it into a ball, then press it with your palms to form a large patty shape of about 10 cm
or 3 ½ inches in diameter. Place onto a griddle or frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until brown on both sides, and serve hot.
Open the arepa and fill it with cheese, ham, eggs, salad or anything else you might put in a sandwich.

About us

The product was intended to bear a name that represented all that an arepa meant, which is that it was to be the "Venezuelan bread" or "pan" in Spanish.
It was thus that it came be called P.A.N., acronym for Productos Alimenticios Nacionales.

On December 10, 1960 P.A.N. was launched and achieved great success, from a complete satisfaction of the Venezuelan consumer.

Today, P.A.N. is found in more than 60 countries, bringing the delicious flavor of corn to consumers in an easy and practical way to prepare their favorite
corn based recipes.

description:
If you want to make soft and delicious pastries, you definitely should use pastry flour. White Wheat Pastry Flour from Food To Live is made by stone-grinding soft wheat. This particular type of flour has a lower gluten content because it has less protein.

By the way, Did you know that protein creates a sticky substance we call gluten when flour mixes with water?

Furthermore, gluten is the element that affects the yeast in the dough. Its chemical love affair makes the yeast rise and stretch.

All-purpose flour has a higher gluten content. Therefore, it’s the right choice for bread and other recipes where the dough needs to rise.

Wheat Pastry Flour works much better for non-rising recipes; it gives your baked goods the delightfully soft and flaky texture by default.


When to Use Soft Wheat Pastry Flour

Sifted Wheat Flour is best used for pie crusts, homemade pasta, cookies, and croissants. You can also use it to make delicious blueberry muffins and cranberry scones. The idea is to use this type of flour when you want the pastries to be soft and fluffy in texture.

Note that soft wheat flour is rather tasteless. Therefore, it’s convenient that it can be used in almost any recipe. We find it works amazingly to make the batter for fried dishes.

A nutty, buttery all purpose flour with a beautiful golden color. Use this whenever your recipe calls for All Purpose.

Origin
Organic Edison comes to us from the fields of our longtime friends Tom and Ray Williams at Hudson Bay Farm in Milton-Freewater, Oregon, which sits on the historic original site of the Hudson Bay Trading Company. Two of our very first growers, Tom and Ray are pioneering organic farmers whose ideas have helped revolutionize the sustainable agricultural practices our flour depends on and they have placed easements on the farm in partnership with the PCC Farmland Trust so that it will never be developed and always remain in agriculture for future generations.

Details
Edison is the hometown favorite. It was named for a town just down the road from the mill, and was bred by retired English Professor Merrill Lewis to thrive in our cool, wet maritime climate. The first thing you notice in this flour is the beautiful golden color. It’s a beautiful addition to any bread or baked good. It has a distinct nutty, buttery flavor that will improve any recipe calling for all purpose flour.

Baking Tips
Even though it is lightly colored, it still has more bran and germ than a typical all purpose flour, so it needs an extra 5% hydration. For every cup of water that your recipe calls for, add in an extra tablespoon. Blend in 20% Edison with any of our bread flours for more golden colored bread or pizza. description:
Organic Kamut Flour (Non-GMO, Bulk)

What Is Kamut Flour Made From?

Organic kamut flour is made from kamut, also known as Khorasan wheat. For centuries it has been consigned to history, but not it made a return. As people look for more nutritious alternatives to staple products, organic kamut flour gains more prominence. It certainly is more beneficial because of its sweet, nutty taste and a higher nutrient content.

Organic kamut grain is very similar to regular wheat, although its seeds are larger. It’s an actual ancestor of wheat but it was forgotten for a very long time. An American airman is responsible for its return to the market. In 1949, when he was in Egypt, he mailed these grains to his family in Montana. The legend has it that he picked up the seeds found in a tomb of an ancient pharaoh.

The Egyptians buried their kings with everything they might need in the afterlife, including the best foods available. The seeds were waiting in the tomb for millennia until they got to grow again.

Of course, that might just be a romanticized version of the actual story. However, the truth is that today, every American can enjoy Organic Kamut Flour from Food To Live. Today this grain remains quite rare. It’s mainly cultivated in Europe. It’s also grown in Montana, US and the seeds even made their way to Australia.

Food To Live Ground Organic Kamut Flour for You

Food To Live Organic Kamut Flour is a product relentlessly tested for quality. The Food To Live facility and procedures comply with the strict USDA guidelines for organic food manufacturers. Both are inspected regularly to ensure the quality of all our products.

description:
Rye is a family of wheat. Whole-grain rye flour contains the highest amount of bran. Therefore it's rich in proteins, vitamins, potassium, iron, and magnesium. Rye flour is popularly used in diets for people with diabetes since the rye's carbohydrates are brake down gradually and, therefore, prevent blood glucose levels from rising quickly. Rye contains many proteins and amino acids, so even athletes can benefit from it in their diet.
How does it taste and how can you use it

Rye flour possesses a unique taste and color. The taste is slightly bitter and nutty, which is surprising for those who like wheat bread.
Another quality of rye flour is its ability to become brown when baked. That is why the crumb of rye bread is always dark.
For a long time, whole rye flour was only for industrial baking of bread. However, nowadays, it is becoming more common, and the number of recipes with rye flour continuously grows. You can make cookies, pancakes, pies, tortillas, and other goodies from it. Different mixing proportions - different properties of your bread
Because bread flour possesses different characteristics than wheat flour, it is rarely used as a substitute. Instead, bakers use it to make a flour mix. Here are some examples of bread with the use of different proportions of rye and wheat flours:
The bread that has up to 40% rye flour, commonly referred to as "rye bread." Rye flour is in a reasonably large proportion here; therefore, there is a distinct rye flavor.
Bread with more than 50% rye flour is entirely different. All the unique characteristics of rye and wheat's chemical differences become more important as the proportion of rye in the dough increases. Typically this bread is flatter and should be allowed to rest for a few hours after baking to prevent crusting.
When there is 70% rye or more, the bread may need to rest for 24 hours, even up to several days, before slicing.

Prepare cachapas or arepas de choclo, corn flatbread, sweetcorn bread, sweet buns, sweetcorn croquettes, stuffed rolls and much more.

How to prepare Cachapas

– 1 cup P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix
– 1 ¼ cups water
– ¼ cup milk
– 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
– Shortening or vegetable oil to grease the pan

PREPARATION

1. Pour water, milk and oil into a bowl. Slowly add P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix and stir until homogeneous. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
2. Pour a portion of the batter with a ladle on a greased hot pan or griddle and spread it to make 5-6 inch wide discs.
3. Cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
4. Side with butter and fresh white cheese, or any other filling of your choice.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. bullet_point: [DELICIOUS FLOUR: Whole-Grain Barley Flour has a delightfully nutty and slightly-sweet flavor that will enhance your dishes., RICH IN NUTRIENTS: Barley is a nutritionally-rich grain, and barley flour also contains a lot of essential vitamins and minerals, including B vitamins, iron, and zinc., GREAT SOURCE OF FIBER: Barley Flour contains about three times more fiber compared to white wheat flour., EASY TO USE: You can use Finely Ground Barley Flour on its own or in flour mixes., VERSATILE FOR BAKING: As it contains a small amount of gluten, Barley Flour great for cookies, muffins, and shortbread.]
description:
You can easily make your baked goods more nutritious and delicious by adding some Barley Flour. Whole-Grain Barley Flour provides you with all the benefits of this incredible grain. It also contains some gluten. Therefore, you can use this flour on its own and not only in mixes since gluten helps the dough rise.

Food To Live Barley Flour is finely ground. It’s made from hulled barley using stone-grinding to minimize the loss of nutrients. By default, barley flour contains almost three times as much fiber as wheat flour.

Barley is also more nutritious than wheat. Therefore, this flour contains more essential minerals (iron and zinc) and B vitamins. The taste of whole-grain barley flour is also different. Whereas white wheat flour is almost tasteless, barley flour is mildly sweet and nutty. Therefore, by using it in a recipe, you enhance its taste even without any additional flavorings.


Finely Ground Barley Flour Uses and Storage Guide

Barley Flour contains some gluten, but only a little of it. Gluten is the ingredient that makes yeast rise and stretch. So this flour is best used in recipes where you don’t need the dough to rise.

For example, it’s the right choice for muffins, cookies, and flatbreads. You can also use it to make delicious and nutritious pancakes for breakfast.

If you want to add the benefits of barley to your bread or even pie crust, you can mix whole-grain barley flour with all-purpose flour.

Barley flour stores for about four months and needs to stay in a cool and dry place. Always keep it in a sealed airtight container. Double-check the seal after every use.

If you want to extend the shelf life of the flour, keep it in the freezer. But make sure that the container you use is 100% airtight. Otherwise, the flour will soak up moisture from the air.

The production process is chemical free. Just by adding water, P.A.N. makes instant corn dough, creating a variety of delicious and easy corn based dishes
that can be adapted to different tastes and customs.

How to Prepare the Dough
Preparing the dough is an easy process:
– Pour 2 ½ cups of water into a container.
– Add salt and gradually mix in 2 ½ cups of corn meal.
– Briefly knead the mixture until a smooth dough is formed and then let it rest for 3 minutes.

How to Prepare Arepas
Separate dough in 10 pieces. Take one portion in your hands and shape it into a ball, then press it with your palms to form a large patty shape of about 10 cm
or 3 ½ inches in diameter. Place onto a griddle or frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until brown on both sides, and serve hot.
Open the arepa and fill it with cheese, ham, eggs, salad or anything else you might put in a sandwich.

About us

The product was intended to bear a name that represented all that an arepa meant, which is that it was to be the "Venezuelan bread" or "pan" in Spanish.
It was thus that it came be called P.A.N., acronym for Productos Alimenticios Nacionales.

On December 10, 1960 P.A.N. was launched and achieved great success, from a complete satisfaction of the Venezuelan consumer.

Today, P.A.N. is found in more than 60 countries, bringing the delicious flavor of corn to consumers in an easy and practical way to prepare their favorite
corn based recipes.

description:
Make your baked goods more delicious and nutritious by adding some Organic Spelt Flour to your recipes. This flour is stone-ground to minimize the loss of nutrients. It's naturally rich in fiber and plant protein, as well as essential minerals. Adding some whole spelt flour to your baked goods will ensure that you are getting some precious iron and zinc every mouthful.

Spelt is an ancient grain and a type of wheat. Therefore, Organic Spelt Wheat Flour isn't gluten-free. However, because of its lighter texture and lower content of gluten, this flour can be an excellent whole wheat alternative. It's safe for people who want to reduce their intake of gluten for dietary reasons.

Stone-ground organic spelt flour is similar to wheat by texture, but the grain itself is much more flavorful. It has a rich nutty and mildly-sweet flavor, without any bitterness of whole wheat.


How to Bake with Organic Spelt Flour

In essence, you can use organic white spelt flour in any recipe that requires wheat flour. It's best to replace about half of the flour in a recipe with spelt flour. It will allow you to see how it works in every recipe, and you can adjust your proportions in the future.

It's important to note that whole wheat spelt flour soaks up less liquid than wheat flour. Therefore, you'll need to cut down the number of liquid ingredients by a little bit. However, you can also add a bit more flour. It is necessary to prevent the dough from being too sticky.

Store your organic stone-ground spelt flour in an airtight container someplace cool and dark. In a pantry or a cupboard, it will last for six months. It will store in the fridge for a year so go ahead and buy Organic Spelt Flour bulk.

Flour from supermarkets tends to be very white, often old, lacking in taste and natural enzymes, and, most important, not very useful for bread baking. Understanding flour types: French flour type numbers indicate the ash content (in milligrams) per 10 g flour. The numbers are a factor 10 lower than the German types. Type 55 is the standard, hard-wheat white flour for baking, including puff pastries (“pâte feuilletée”). Type 45 is often called pastry flour, and is generally from a softer wheat (this corresponds to what older French texts call “farine de gruau”). Some recipes use Type 45 for croissants although many French bakers use Type 55 or a combination of Types 45 and 55. Types 65, 80, and 110 are strong bread flours of increasing darkness, and type 150 is a wholemeal flour. Note that there is no type 40 French flour like the German type 405, the closest is type 45.

description: Hard Red Whole Wheat Flour is typically known as traditional "whole wheat" flour which results in outstanding baking characteristics. Azure Market's Hard Red Whole Wheat Unifine Flour is uniquely milled resulting in a fine flour, with high protein levels (about 14%). All natural, no preservatives or additives, no bleaching or enriching. Wheat is sourced from organic farms in the USA. Azure Standard’s Unifine flour is milled at the Azure Farm Mill in Dufur, Ore., one of only a few such mills in the world, and family owned. The name “Unifine” comes from the milling process itself, where it takes just one step (uni) to produce a very fine, uniform consistency, while also preserving the natural nutrients of the grain. With Unifine Milling, the grain enters a high speed rotor with a single-pass impact system that instantly pulverizes the kernels with little heat involved, bursting into fine flour at a cool temperature. With this unique, one-step milling process the entire bran, germ and endosperm of the grain are retained, resulting in superior nutritious flour, and the oil molecules are left intact resulting in a longer shelf life. Ultimately, Unifine milled flours from Azure are packed with many times the nutritional value compared with commercially milled flours. It has almost four times as much dietary fiber, more than twice as much potassium, and three times the magnesium. Whole grain Unifine Flours require the baker to use significantly more water than commercial white flours or other milled brands. With germ and bran intact, there should be less mixing or kneading, and longer time allowed for fermentation and rising. Baking with organic whole grain flours may take some practice and experimentation, but the resulting nutrition and superior taste are worth it.

description:
What is Oat Bran? 
Naturally sourced from oats, oat bran is the outermost layer of oat groats that is often removed during processing, although it can be found in some steel-cut oats. This tasty grain-based product offers a nutrient-dense profile and a delicious mild nutty flavor that’s ideal for using in a variety of baked goods, hot cereals, savory dishes and more.

Why Use Oat Bran?
Widely regarded as one of the most nutritious grains in the world, oats are filled with essential vitamins, minerals and fiber. The outermost layer of processed oats, also known as oat bran, is filled with many of these vitamins and minerals to offer a wide variety of full body benefits.
One of the main benefits of oat bran is its nutrient-dense nature. In fact, this nutritious grain features more protein and fiber than standard oats as well as essential nutrients such as thiamine, magnesium and iron. Additionally, oat bran is naturally high in free radical-fighting antioxidants and low in calories, too, making it an ideal addition to any gluten-free, keto or Dukan diet.

How to Use Oat Bran
Our delicious Oat Bran is easy to add to any diet and even easier to enjoy with its mellow nutty flavor and smooth texture. Mix it into your morning hot cereal or oatmeal for an added boost of nutrition. Add a cup to your baked goods such as bran muffins or oatmeal cookies for a touch of crunchy texture and a beneficial boost. description: Organic Spelt Unifine Flour is recognized for its ease in baking with results that are similar to using whole wheat flour. While this flour is not considered gluten-free, it is an excellent substitute for plain wheat flour as it adds a wonderful flavor and consistency with less gluten. Azure Standard’s Unifine flour is milled at the Azure Farm Mill in Dufur, Ore., one of only a few such mills in the world, and family owned. The name “Unifine” comes from the milling process itself, where it takes just one step (uni) to produce a very fine, uniform consistency, while also preserving the natural nutrients of the grain. With Unifine Milling, the grain enters a high speed rotor with a single-pass impact system that instantly pulverizes the kernels with little heat involved, bursting into fine flour at a cool temperature. With this unique, one-step milling process the entire bran, germ and endosperm of the grain are retained, resulting in superior nutritious flour, and the oil molecules are left intact resulting in a longer shelf life. Ultimately, Unifine milled flours from Azure are packed with many times the nutritional value compared with commercially milled flours. It has almost four times as much dietary fiber, more than twice as much potassium, and three times the magnesium. Whole grain Unifine Flours require the baker to use significantly more water than commercial white flours or other milled brands. With germ and bran intact, there should be less mixing or kneading, and longer time allowed for fermentation and rising. Baking with organic whole grain flours may take some practice and experimentation, but the resulting nutrition and superior taste are worth it.

description:
Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

Great River Organic Milling se encuentra en la parte superior del río Mississippi, en el corazón de lo que se llama el Valle de Hiawatha. La belleza natural de la zona es un recordatorio constante de la importancia de nuestro compromiso con la agricultura orgánica. La agricultura orgánica o sostenible es más que la evitación de fertilizantes químicos y pesticidas. Una granja orgánica se esfuerza por proteger nuestro medio ambiente mediante la construcción y el mantenimiento de suelos saludables que, a su vez, mejora la calidad del agua y del aire. Se ha demostrado que los granos y otros cultivos alimenticios cultivados en un suelo saludable, resisten mejor a las plagas y enfermedades que los cultivos cultivados convencionalmente y también contienen nutrientes más vitales importantes para los seres humanos. El consumo de alimentos orgánicos promueve la salud de las personas y la tierra en la que se cultivó. Al apoyar la agricultura orgánica promovemos el ciclo de un ambiente saludable que incluye la vida de microorganismos, plantas y humanos. La mayor parte de la harina del Gran Río es de piedra molida. Creemos que las piedras de molino de granito natural contribuyen a la calidad, el sabor y la integridad nutricional de la harina de grano entero. El grano que fluye en las piedras se vuelve muy delgado, copos planos que integra todas las partes del trigo inmediatamente en la harina, permitiendo que la harina tenga más sabor. Las temperaturas más frías que se producen durante el fresado con piedras permiten que continúe la actividad enzimática importante. También se mantienen los niveles de proteínas. Nuestras harinas molidas de piedra se molen a pedido, para conservar el valor nutricional de la harina. Great River está certificado orgánico por Quality Assurance International y Kosher aprobado. La obtención de nuestra certificación requiere una inspección anual de nuestras instalaciones de fresado y registros para asegurar que nuestros productos cumplan con los estándares de la industria.

Great River Organic Milling befindet sich am oberen Mississippi Fluss, im Herzen des Hiawatha Valley. Die natürliche Schönheit der Gegend erinnert immer an die Bedeutung unseres Engagements für die biologische Landwirtschaft. Die biologische oder nachhaltige Landwirtschaft ist mehr als die Vermeidung von chemischen Düngemitteln und Pestiziden. Eine Bio-Farm strebt danach, unsere Umwelt zu schützen, indem sie einen gesunden Boden aufbauen und pflegen, der wiederum die Wasser- und Luftqualität verbessert. Es wurde gezeigt, dass Getreide und andere Lebensmittelpflanzen, die in einem gesunden Boden angebaut werden, Schädlingen und Krankheiten besser widerstehen als konventionell gewachsene Kulturen und auch mehr lebenswichtige Nährstoffe enthalten, die für den Menschen wichtig sind. Der Verzehr von biologischen Lebensmitteln fördert die Gesundheit der Menschen und das Land, auf dem es angebaut wurde. Zur Unterstützung der biologischen Landwirtschaft fördern wir den Kreislauf einer gesunden Umwelt, die das Leben von Mikroorganismen, Pflanzen und Menschen umfasst. Most Great River Mehl ist steingemahlen. Wir glauben, dass die natürlichen Granitmühlsteine zur Qualität, Geschmack und Nährstoffintegrität von Vollkornmehl beitragen. Getreide, das in die Steine fließt, werden sehr dünne, flache Flocken, die alle Teile des Weizens sofort in das Mehl integrieren, sodass das Mehl mehr Geschmack hat. Die kühleren Temperaturen, die beim Fräsen mit Steinen auftreten, lassen wichtige Enzymaktivität fortsetzen. Auch der Proteinspiegel wird beibehalten. Unsere steingemahlenen Mehle werden auf Bestellung gemahlen, um den Nährwert des Mehls zu erhalten. Great River ist organisch zertifiziert durch Qualitätssicherung International und koscher genehmigt. Die Erhaltung unserer Zertifizierung erfordert eine jährliche Inspektion unserer Fräsanlage und Aufzeichnungen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produkte den Industriestandards entsprechen.

טחינה אורגנית של Great River ממוקמת על נהר מיסיסיפי העליון, בלב מה שנקרא עמק Hiawatha. היופי הטבעי של האזור הוא תזכורת מתמדת לחשיבות המחויבות שלנו לחקלאות אורגנית. חקלאות אורגנית או בת קיימא היא יותר מאשר הימנעות מדשנים כימיים וחומרי הדברה. חווה אורגנית שואפת להגן על הסביבה שלנו על ידי בנייה ושמירה על קרקע בריאה, אשר, בתורו, משפר את איכות המים והאוויר. הוכח כי דגנים וגידולי מזון אחרים הגדלים באדמה בריאה, עמידים בפני מזיקים ומחלות טוב יותר מאשר יבולים שגדלו באופן רגיל וגם מכילים יותר חומרים מזינים חשובים לבני אדם. צריכת מזון אורגני מקדמת את בריאותם של אנשים ואת הארץ שעליה גדלה. בתמיכה בחקלאות אורגנית אנו מקדמים את מחזור הסביבה הבריאה הכוללת את חייהם של מיקרואורגניזמים, צמחים ובני אדם. קמח הנהר הגדול ביותר הוא קרקע אבן. אנו מאמינים שאבני הרחיים הגרניט הטבעיים תורמים לאיכות, לטעם ולשלמות התזונתית של קמח דגנים מלאים. גרגרים הזורמים לתוך האבנים הופכים לדקים מאוד, פתיתים שטוחים המשלבים את כל חלקי החיטה מיד לתוך הקמח, ומאפשרים לקמח להיות יותר טעם. הטמפרטורות הקרירות המתרחשות במהלך טחינה עם אבנים מאפשרות פעילות אנזים חשובה להמשיך. גם רמות חלבון נשמרות ברמות. הקמחים שלנו טחונים לפי הזמנה, כדי לשמור על הערך התזונתי של הקמח. Great River מוסמך אורגני על ידי בקרת איכות בינלאומית ומאושר כשרות. קבלת האישורים שלנו דורשת בדיקה שנתית של מתקן הטחינה והרשומות שלנו כדי להבטיח שהמוצרים שלנו עומדים בסטנדרטים של התעשייה.

تقع جريت ريفر أورجانيك ميللينغ على نهر ميسيسيبي، في قلب ما يُسمى وادي هاواثا. الجمال الطبيعي للمنطقة هو تذكير دائم بأهمية التزامنا بالزراعة العضوية. الزراعة العضوية أو المستدامة أكثر من تجنب الأسمدة الكيميائية والمبيدات الحشرية. تسعى مزرعة عضوية لحماية بيئتنا من خلال بناء والحفاظ على تربة صحية والتي تعمل بدورها على تحسين جودة المياه والهواء. لقد ثبت أن الحبوب والمحاصيل الأخرى الغذائية تنمو في تربة صحية وتقاوم الآفات والأمراض بشكل أفضل من المحاصيل المزروعة تقليديًا وتحتوي أيضًا على مغذيات حيوية أكثر أهمية للبشر. استهلاك الأطعمة العضوية يعزز صحة الأفراد والأرض التي تنمو عليها. من خلال دعم الزراعة العضوية، فإننا نعزز دورة البيئة الصحية التي تشمل حياة الكائنات الحية الدقيقة والنباتات والبشر. معظم طحين نهر جريت ريفر مطحون بالحجر. نحن نؤمن بأن أحجار الجرانيت الطبيعية تساهم في جودة الطحين والطعم والسلامة الغذائية الكاملة. تصبح الحبوب التي تتدفق إلى الأحجار رقيقة جدًا، ورقائق مسطحة تدمج جميع أجزاء القمح على الفور في الطحين، مما يسمح للدقيق بالحصول على المزيد من النكهة. تسمح درجات الحرارة الأكثر برودة التي تحدث أثناء الطحن بالحجارة بالاستمرار في نشاط الإنزيم المهم. كما يتم الحفاظ على مستويات البروتين. الطحين الحجري المطحون لدينا يتم طحنه حسب الطلب، للحفاظ على القيمة الغذائية للطحين. منتج جريت ريفر عضوي معتمد من مؤسسة ضمان الجودة الدولية ومعتمد من الشريعة اليهودية. يتطلب الحصول على شهادتنا فحصًا سنوياً لمنشأة الطحن وسجلات للتأكد من أن منتجاتنا تلبي المعايير الصناعية.

A Great River Organic Milling está localizada no alto rio Mississippi, no coração do que é chamado de Vale Hiawatha. A beleza natural da região é um lembrete constante da importância do nosso compromisso com a agricultura orgânica. Agricultura orgânica ou sustentável é mais do que evitar adubos químicos e pesticidas. Uma fazenda orgânica se esforça para proteger o nosso meio ambiente, construindo e mantendo solo saudável que, por sua vez, melhora a qualidade da água e do ar. Foi mostrado que grãos e outras culturas alimentares cultivadas em um solo saudável, resistem a pragas e doenças melhor do que culturas convencionais e também contêm nutrientes mais vitais importantes para os seres humanos. Consumir alimentos orgânicos promove a saúde das pessoas e a terra em que foi cultivada. Ao apoiar a agricultura orgânica, promovemos o ciclo de um ambiente saudável que inclui a vida de microrganismos, plantas e seres humanos. A farinha de Great River é moída em pedra. Acreditamos que as pedras de granito naturais contribuem para a qualidade, sabor e integridade nutricional da farinha de flor integral. O grão que flui nas pedras torna-se muito fino e plano, que integra todas as partes do trigo imediatamente à farinha, permitindo que a farinha tenha mais sabor. As temperaturas mais frias que ocorrem durante a moagem com pedras permitem que a atividade enzimática importante continue. Os níveis de proteína também são mantidos. Nossas farinhas moídas em pedra são moídas sob encomenda, para reter o valor nutricional da farinha. Great River é certificado orgânico pela Quality Assurance International e aprovado pela Kosher. Obter nossa certificação requer uma inspeção anual de nossas instalações de fresagem e registros para garantir que nossos produtos atendam aos padrões da indústria.

Great River Organic Milling 位於密西西比河上岸,位於所謂的 Hiawatha 山谷的中心。 該地區的自然美不斷地提醒我們對於有機農業承諾的重要性。 ​ 有機或可持續的農業不僅僅是避免化學肥料和殺蟲劑。 有機農場致力於通過建造和維持健康的土壤來保護環境,進而改善水和空氣質量。 已顯示,穀物和其他食物作物生長在健康的土壤中,比傳統種植的作物更好抵抗害蟲和疾病,也含有更多對人類重要的營養素。 食用有機食物可促進個人健康,促進其生長的土地。 ​ 支持有機農業,我們促進健康環境的循環,包括微生物、植物和人類的生活。 ​ 大多數 Great River 麵粉都是石地。 我們相信天然花崗岩磨石有助於全穀物麵粉的品質、味道和營養完整性。 流入石頭的穀物變得非常薄,扁平的薄片,可立即將小麥的所有部分整合到麵粉中,讓麵粉有更多的味道。 在用石頭研磨過程中出現的更涼溫度,使重要的酶活性得以繼續。 ​ 蛋白質水平也保持不變。 我們的石粉是按訂單研磨的,以保留麵粉的營養價值。 ​ Great River 通過 Quality Assurance International 有機認證,並獲得猶太認證。 要獲得我們的認證,必須對我們的銑削設施和記錄進行年度檢查,以確保我們的產品符合行業標準。

Great River 有机研磨位于密西西比河上部,所谓的海华达山谷中心。 该地区的自然美不断提醒着我们对有机农业的承诺的重要性。 有机或可持续的农业不仅仅是避免化学肥料和农药。 一个有机农场努力通过建造和维护健康的土壤来保护我们的环境,从而提高水和空气质量。 研究表明,谷物和其他食品作物在健康的土壤中生长,抵抗害虫和疾病,比常规种植的作物更好,而且含有对人体重要的营养素。 有机食物可促进个人和其生长地的健康。 为了支持有机农业,我们促进包括微生物、植物和人类的生命在内的健康环境循环。 大部分 Great River 面粉是石粉的。 我们相信天然花岗岩磨石有助于全谷物面粉的质量、味道和营养完整性。 谷物流入石头变得非常薄,扁平的薄片将小麦的所有部分都整合到面粉中,让面粉具有更多的味道。 在石头研磨过程中发生的较冷温度使重要的酶活性得以继续。 蛋白质水平也维持。 我们的石粉按订单打磨,以保持面粉的营养价值。 Great River 经过国际质量保证和犹太洁食认证。 要获得我们的认证,需要每年检查我们的铣削设备和记录,以确保我们的产品符合行业标准。

그레이트 리버 오가닉 밀링은 히아와타 계곡이라고 불리는 중심부 미시피 강 위쪽에 위치해 있습니다. 이 지역의 자연스러운 아름다움은 유기농 농업에 대한 당사의 헌신의 중요성을 지속적으로 상기시킵니다. 유기농이거나 지속 가능한 농업은 화학 비료 및 살충제를 피하는 것 이상입니다. 유기농 농장은 물과 공기 품질을 향상시키는 건강한 토양을 만들고 유지하여 환경을 보호하기 위해 노력합니다. 건강한 토양에서 자란 곡물 및 기타 식품 작물은 기존의 재배된 작물보다 해충과 질병에 저항하며 인간에게 중요한 영양소를 더 많이 함유하고 있다는 것이 밝혀졌습니다. 유기농 식품을 섭취하면 개인과 성장한 땅의 건강을 증진시킵니다. 유기농 농업을 지원하는 데 있어 미생물, 식물 및 인간의 삶을 포함한 건강한 환경의 사이클을 촉진합니다. 대부분의 그레이트 리버 밀가루는 돌로 갈아 만들었습니다. 저희는 천연 화강암 맷돌이 통곡물 가루의 품질, 맛 및 영양 무결성에 기여한다고 믿습니다. 돌로 흐르는 곡물은 매우 얇고 평평한 조각이 되어 밀의 모든 부분을 밀가루에 즉시 통합하여 밀가루에 더 많은 맛을 낼 수 있습니다. 스톤으로 밀링 중에 발생하는 더 차가운 온도는 중요한 효소 활동을 계속할 수 있게 합니다. 단백질 수준도 유지됩니다. 당사의 석재 분쇄 가루는 밀가루의 영양 가치를 유지하기 위해 주문에 따라 가공됩니다. Great River는 국제 품질 보증 및 코셔 승인을 받은 유기농 인증을 받았습니다. 인증을 획득하려면 당사의 밀링 시설과 기록을 매년 검사하여 제품이 업계 표준을 충족하는지 확인해야 합니다.

description:
Delicious arepas can now be your specialty! Harina P.A.N. is one of the most popular brands of corn flour. Versatile and perfect for a wide range of
dishes such as arepas, empanadas, cornbread, bollos, hallacas, pupusas, tamales to mention just a few.

How to Prepare the Dough
Preparing the dough is an easy process:
– Pour 2 ½ cups of water into a container.
– Add salt and gradually mix in 2 ½ cups of corn meal.
– Briefly knead the mixture until a smooth dough is formed and then let it rest for 3 minutes.

How to Prepare Arepas
Separate dough in 10 pieces. Take one portion in your hands and shape it into a ball, then press it with your palms to form a large patty shape of about 10 cm
or 3 ½ inches in diameter. Place onto a griddle or frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until brown on both sides, and serve hot.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. description: Neapolitan pizza dough Makes 48 ounces dough or five 9.5-ounce portions, enough for five 9-inch pizzas INGREDIENTS: 1/2 teaspoon (3 grams) fresh cake yeast 2 cups lukewarm water (90° to 100°F) 1 tablespoon table salt or fine sea salt 2 lbs/910 g Caputo flour plus more for dusting INSTRUCTIONS: In a small bowl, using a fork, stir the yeast into 1 cup of the lukewarm water. Set aside until the yeast dissolves, about 5 minutes. In another small bowl, combine the salt and remaining 1 cup water. Stir to dissolve the salt. To make the dough by hand: Place 7 1/4 cups (2 pounds) of the flour in a large bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour and stir in the yeast mixture, along with the saltwater mixture. Using a wooden spoon, mix the dough, incorporating as much of the flour as possible. Turn the dough out on a lightly floured work surface and knead until soft and elastic, 12 to 15 minutes. It will still be a little sticky but shouldn’t stick to your hands. Add only a minimum amount of flour to the work surface to keep the dough from sticking. To prepare the dough for rising: Cut the dough into fifths to form five even portions, each weighing 9.5 ounces. Pick up one portion of dough and pull the opposite edges together, wrapping them underneath towards the center to form a tight, smooth ball. Pinch to seal. Repeat with the other four portions. Place each portion in a 1-gallon lock-top plastic bag. Squeeze out all the air and seal the bag, allowing enough room for the dough to double in size. Let rise in a cool room (about 60°F) for 6 to 8 hours. Alternatively, refrigerate for at least 10 hours or up to 24 hours. Remove from the refrigerator 3 hours before using to allow the dough to come to room temperature. Proceed with any Neapolitan pizza recipe.

An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

טחינה אורגנית של Great River ממוקמת על נהר מיסיסיפי העליון, בלב מה שנקרא עמק Hiawatha. היופי הטבעי של האזור הוא תזכורת מתמדת לחשיבות המחויבות שלנו לחקלאות אורגנית. חקלאות אורגנית או בת קיימא היא יותר מאשר הימנעות מדשנים כימיים וחומרי הדברה. חווה אורגנית שואפת להגן על הסביבה שלנו על ידי בנייה ושמירה על קרקע בריאה, אשר, בתורו, משפר את איכות המים והאוויר. הוכח כי דגנים וגידולי מזון אחרים הגדלים באדמה בריאה, עמידים בפני מזיקים ומחלות טוב יותר מאשר יבולים שגדלו באופן רגיל וגם מכילים יותר חומרים מזינים חשובים לבני אדם. צריכת מזון אורגני מקדמת את בריאותם של אנשים ואת הארץ שעליה גדלה. בתמיכה בחקלאות אורגנית אנו מקדמים את מחזור הסביבה הבריאה הכוללת את חייהם של מיקרואורגניזמים, צמחים ובני אדם. קמח הנהר הגדול ביותר הוא קרקע אבן. אנו מאמינים שאבני הרחיים הגרניט הטבעיים תורמים לאיכות, לטעם ולשלמות התזונתית של קמח דגנים מלאים. גרגרים הזורמים לתוך האבנים הופכים לדקים מאוד, פתיתים שטוחים המשלבים את כל חלקי החיטה מיד לתוך הקמח, ומאפשרים לקמח להיות יותר טעם. הטמפרטורות הקרירות המתרחשות במהלך טחינה עם אבנים מאפשרות פעילות אנזים חשובה להמשיך. גם רמות חלבון נשמרות ברמות. הקמחים שלנו טחונים לפי הזמנה, כדי לשמור על הערך התזונתי של הקמח. Great River מוסמך אורגני על ידי בקרת איכות בינלאומית ומאושר כשרות. קבלת האישורים שלנו דורשת בדיקה שנתית של מתקן הטחינה והרשומות שלנו כדי להבטיח שהמוצרים שלנו עומדים בסטנדרטים של התעשייה.

Great River Organic Milling befindet sich am oberen Mississippi Fluss, im Herzen des Hiawatha Valley. Die natürliche Schönheit der Gegend erinnert immer an die Bedeutung unseres Engagements für die biologische Landwirtschaft. Die biologische oder nachhaltige Landwirtschaft ist mehr als die Vermeidung von chemischen Düngemitteln und Pestiziden. Eine Bio-Farm strebt danach, unsere Umwelt zu schützen, indem sie einen gesunden Boden aufbauen und pflegen, der wiederum die Wasser- und Luftqualität verbessert. Es wurde gezeigt, dass Getreide und andere Lebensmittelpflanzen, die in einem gesunden Boden angebaut werden, Schädlingen und Krankheiten besser widerstehen als konventionell gewachsene Kulturen und auch mehr lebenswichtige Nährstoffe enthalten, die für den Menschen wichtig sind. Der Verzehr von biologischen Lebensmitteln fördert die Gesundheit der Menschen und das Land, auf dem es angebaut wurde. Zur Unterstützung der biologischen Landwirtschaft fördern wir den Kreislauf einer gesunden Umwelt, die das Leben von Mikroorganismen, Pflanzen und Menschen umfasst. Most Great River Mehl ist steingemahlen. Wir glauben, dass die natürlichen Granitmühlsteine zur Qualität, Geschmack und Nährstoffintegrität von Vollkornmehl beitragen. Getreide, das in die Steine fließt, werden sehr dünne, flache Flocken, die alle Teile des Weizens sofort in das Mehl integrieren, sodass das Mehl mehr Geschmack hat. Die kühleren Temperaturen, die beim Fräsen mit Steinen auftreten, lassen wichtige Enzymaktivität fortsetzen. Auch der Proteinspiegel wird beibehalten. Unsere steingemahlenen Mehle werden auf Bestellung gemahlen, um den Nährwert des Mehls zu erhalten. Great River ist organisch zertifiziert durch Qualitätssicherung International und koscher genehmigt. Die Erhaltung unserer Zertifizierung erfordert eine jährliche Inspektion unserer Fräsanlage und Aufzeichnungen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produkte den Industriestandards entsprechen.

تقع جريت ريفر أورجانيك ميللينغ على نهر ميسيسيبي، في قلب ما يُسمى وادي هاواثا. الجمال الطبيعي للمنطقة هو تذكير دائم بأهمية التزامنا بالزراعة العضوية. الزراعة العضوية أو المستدامة أكثر من تجنب الأسمدة الكيميائية والمبيدات الحشرية. تسعى مزرعة عضوية لحماية بيئتنا من خلال بناء والحفاظ على تربة صحية والتي تعمل بدورها على تحسين جودة المياه والهواء. لقد ثبت أن الحبوب والمحاصيل الأخرى الغذائية تنمو في تربة صحية وتقاوم الآفات والأمراض بشكل أفضل من المحاصيل المزروعة تقليديًا وتحتوي أيضًا على مغذيات حيوية أكثر أهمية للبشر. استهلاك الأطعمة العضوية يعزز صحة الأفراد والأرض التي تنمو عليها. من خلال دعم الزراعة العضوية، فإننا نعزز دورة البيئة الصحية التي تشمل حياة الكائنات الحية الدقيقة والنباتات والبشر. معظم طحين نهر جريت ريفر مطحون بالحجر. نحن نؤمن بأن أحجار الجرانيت الطبيعية تساهم في جودة الطحين والطعم والسلامة الغذائية الكاملة. تصبح الحبوب التي تتدفق إلى الأحجار رقيقة جدًا، ورقائق مسطحة تدمج جميع أجزاء القمح على الفور في الطحين، مما يسمح للدقيق بالحصول على المزيد من النكهة. تسمح درجات الحرارة الأكثر برودة التي تحدث أثناء الطحن بالحجارة بالاستمرار في نشاط الإنزيم المهم. كما يتم الحفاظ على مستويات البروتين. الطحين الحجري المطحون لدينا يتم طحنه حسب الطلب، للحفاظ على القيمة الغذائية للطحين. منتج جريت ريفر عضوي معتمد من مؤسسة ضمان الجودة الدولية ومعتمد من الشريعة اليهودية. يتطلب الحصول على شهادتنا فحصًا سنوياً لمنشأة الطحن وسجلات للتأكد من أن منتجاتنا تلبي المعايير الصناعية.

A Great River Organic Milling está localizada no alto rio Mississippi, no coração do que é chamado de Vale Hiawatha. A beleza natural da região é um lembrete constante da importância do nosso compromisso com a agricultura orgânica. Agricultura orgânica ou sustentável é mais do que evitar adubos químicos e pesticidas. Uma fazenda orgânica se esforça para proteger o nosso meio ambiente, construindo e mantendo solo saudável que, por sua vez, melhora a qualidade da água e do ar. Foi mostrado que grãos e outras culturas alimentares cultivadas em um solo saudável, resistem a pragas e doenças melhor do que culturas convencionais e também contêm nutrientes mais vitais importantes para os seres humanos. Consumir alimentos orgânicos promove a saúde das pessoas e a terra em que foi cultivada. Ao apoiar a agricultura orgânica, promovemos o ciclo de um ambiente saudável que inclui a vida de microrganismos, plantas e seres humanos. A farinha de Great River é moída em pedra. Acreditamos que as pedras de granito naturais contribuem para a qualidade, sabor e integridade nutricional da farinha de flor integral. O grão que flui nas pedras torna-se muito fino e plano, que integra todas as partes do trigo imediatamente à farinha, permitindo que a farinha tenha mais sabor. As temperaturas mais frias que ocorrem durante a moagem com pedras permitem que a atividade enzimática importante continue. Os níveis de proteína também são mantidos. Nossas farinhas moídas em pedra são moídas sob encomenda, para reter o valor nutricional da farinha. Great River é certificado orgânico pela Quality Assurance International e aprovado pela Kosher. Obter nossa certificação requer uma inspeção anual de nossas instalações de fresagem e registros para garantir que nossos produtos atendam aos padrões da indústria.

Great River 有机研磨位于密西西比河上部,所谓的海华达山谷中心。 该地区的自然美不断提醒着我们对有机农业的承诺的重要性。 有机或可持续的农业不仅仅是避免化学肥料和农药。 一个有机农场努力通过建造和维护健康的土壤来保护我们的环境,从而提高水和空气质量。 研究表明,谷物和其他食品作物在健康的土壤中生长,抵抗害虫和疾病,比常规种植的作物更好,而且含有对人体重要的营养素。 有机食物可促进个人和其生长地的健康。 为了支持有机农业,我们促进包括微生物、植物和人类的生命在内的健康环境循环。 大部分 Great River 面粉是石粉的。 我们相信天然花岗岩磨石有助于全谷物面粉的质量、味道和营养完整性。 谷物流入石头变得非常薄,扁平的薄片将小麦的所有部分都整合到面粉中,让面粉具有更多的味道。 在石头研磨过程中发生的较冷温度使重要的酶活性得以继续。 蛋白质水平也维持。 我们的石粉按订单打磨,以保持面粉的营养价值。 Great River 经过国际质量保证和犹太洁食认证。 要获得我们的认证,需要每年检查我们的铣削设备和记录,以确保我们的产品符合行业标准。

Great River Organic Milling 位於密西西比河上岸,位於所謂的 Hiawatha 山谷的中心。 該地區的自然美不斷地提醒我們對於有機農業承諾的重要性。 ​ 有機或可持續的農業不僅僅是避免化學肥料和殺蟲劑。 有機農場致力於通過建造和維持健康的土壤來保護環境,進而改善水和空氣質量。 已顯示,穀物和其他食物作物生長在健康的土壤中,比傳統種植的作物更好抵抗害蟲和疾病,也含有更多對人類重要的營養素。 食用有機食物可促進個人健康,促進其生長的土地。 ​ 支持有機農業,我們促進健康環境的循環,包括微生物、植物和人類的生活。 ​ 大多數 Great River 麵粉都是石地。 我們相信天然花崗岩磨石有助於全穀物麵粉的品質、味道和營養完整性。 流入石頭的穀物變得非常薄,扁平的薄片,可立即將小麥的所有部分整合到麵粉中,讓麵粉有更多的味道。 在用石頭研磨過程中出現的更涼溫度,使重要的酶活性得以繼續。 ​ 蛋白質水平也保持不變。 我們的石粉是按訂單研磨的,以保留麵粉的營養價值。 ​ Great River 通過 Quality Assurance International 有機認證,並獲得猶太認證。 要獲得我們的認證,必須對我們的銑削設施和記錄進行年度檢查,以確保我們的產品符合行業標準。

그레이트 리버 오가닉 밀링은 히아와타 계곡이라고 불리는 중심부 미시피 강 위쪽에 위치해 있습니다. 이 지역의 자연스러운 아름다움은 유기농 농업에 대한 당사의 헌신의 중요성을 지속적으로 상기시킵니다. 유기농이거나 지속 가능한 농업은 화학 비료 및 살충제를 피하는 것 이상입니다. 유기농 농장은 물과 공기 품질을 향상시키는 건강한 토양을 만들고 유지하여 환경을 보호하기 위해 노력합니다. 건강한 토양에서 자란 곡물 및 기타 식품 작물은 기존의 재배된 작물보다 해충과 질병에 저항하며 인간에게 중요한 영양소를 더 많이 함유하고 있다는 것이 밝혀졌습니다. 유기농 식품을 섭취하면 개인과 성장한 땅의 건강을 증진시킵니다. 유기농 농업을 지원하는 데 있어 미생물, 식물 및 인간의 삶을 포함한 건강한 환경의 사이클을 촉진합니다. 대부분의 그레이트 리버 밀가루는 돌로 갈아 만들었습니다. 저희는 천연 화강암 맷돌이 통곡물 가루의 품질, 맛 및 영양 무결성에 기여한다고 믿습니다. 돌로 흐르는 곡물은 매우 얇고 평평한 조각이 되어 밀의 모든 부분을 밀가루에 즉시 통합하여 밀가루에 더 많은 맛을 낼 수 있습니다. 스톤으로 밀링 중에 발생하는 더 차가운 온도는 중요한 효소 활동을 계속할 수 있게 합니다. 단백질 수준도 유지됩니다. 당사의 석재 분쇄 가루는 밀가루의 영양 가치를 유지하기 위해 주문에 따라 가공됩니다. Great River는 국제 품질 보증 및 코셔 승인을 받은 유기농 인증을 받았습니다. 인증을 획득하려면 당사의 밀링 시설과 기록을 매년 검사하여 제품이 업계 표준을 충족하는지 확인해야 합니다.

Organic Kamut Flour (Non-GMO, Bulk)

What Is Kamut Flour Made From?

Organic kamut flour is made from kamut, also known as Khorasan wheat. For centuries it has been consigned to history, but not it made a return. As people look for more nutritious alternatives to staple products, organic kamut flour gains more prominence. It certainly is more beneficial because of its sweet, nutty taste and a higher nutrient content.

Organic kamut grain is very similar to regular wheat, although its seeds are larger. It’s an actual ancestor of wheat but it was forgotten for a very long time. An American airman is responsible for its return to the market. In 1949, when he was in Egypt, he mailed these grains to his family in Montana. The legend has it that he picked up the seeds found in a tomb of an ancient pharaoh.

The Egyptians buried their kings with everything they might need in the afterlife, including the best foods available. The seeds were waiting in the tomb for millennia until they got to grow again.

Of course, that might just be a romanticized version of the actual story. However, the truth is that today, every American can enjoy Organic Kamut Flour from Food To Live. Today this grain remains quite rare. It’s mainly cultivated in Europe. It’s also grown in Montana, US and the seeds even made their way to Australia.

Food To Live Ground Organic Kamut Flour for You

description:
Hi, my name is Hannah and I am the founder of Spera Foods and I want to tell you a little bit about our tiger nut flour. Ingredients and Measurements

  • 2 1/4 cups tiger nut flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 cup butter or coconut oil softened
  • 3/4th cup coconut sugar
  • 1 tsp Vanilla extract
  • 2 eggs or vegan egg substitute
  • 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips or cocoa nibs

    • Instructions

    Combine all dry dry ingredients except chocolate in a bowl and set aside. Beat butter or coconut oil sugar, and vanilla until well combined. Then add eggs one at a time. Next add the flour gradually. Works great as cookies cooked at 350 F for 8-10 min or as cookie bars in a 15x 10 pan for 20-25 min.

I began to combine and experiment in different ways to create foods and recipes that allowed for people not only to eat healthy, but to enjoy what they were eating. Healthy food can and should taste just as good as food that is unhealthy. We have found at Spera all this requires is passion, dedication, and hard work. description:

►Corn starch, maize starch, or cornflour is the starch derived from corn grain. The starch is obtained from the endosperm of the kernel. Corn flour is usually yellow, but it can also be white or blue depending on the variety of corn it uses. The texture is fine and smooth, similar to whole wheat flour.

The name “Unifine” comes from the milling process itself, where it takes just one step (uni) to produce a very fine, uniform consistency, while also preserving the natural nutrients of the grain. With Unifine Milling, the grain enters a high speed rotor with a single-pass impact system that instantly pulverizes the kernels with little heat involved, bursting into fine flour at a cool temperature. What Is Kamut Flour Made From?

Organic kamut flour is made from kamut, also known as Khorasan wheat. For centuries it has been consigned to history, but not it made a return. As people look for more nutritious alternatives to staple products, organic kamut flour gains more prominence. It certainly is more beneficial because of its sweet, nutty taste and a higher nutrient content.

Organic kamut grain is very similar to regular wheat, although its seeds are larger. It’s an actual ancestor of wheat but it was forgotten for a very long time. An American airman is responsible for its return to the market. In 1949, when he was in Egypt, he mailed these grains to his family in Montana. The legend has it that he picked up the seeds found in a tomb of an ancient pharaoh.

The Egyptians buried their kings with everything they might need in the afterlife, including the best foods available. The seeds were waiting in the tomb for millennia until they got to grow again.

Of course, that might just be a romanticized version of the actual story. However, the truth is that today, every American can enjoy Organic Kamut Flour from Food To Live. Today this grain remains quite rare. It’s mainly cultivated in Europe. It’s also grown in Montana, US and the seeds even made their way to Australia.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. If you want to make soft and delicious pastries, you definitely should use pastry flour. White Wheat Pastry Flour from Food To Live is made by stone-grinding soft wheat. This particular type of flour has a lower gluten content because it has less protein.

By the way, Did you know that protein creates a sticky substance we call gluten when flour mixes with water?

Furthermore, gluten is the element that affects the yeast in the dough. Its chemical love affair makes the yeast rise and stretch.

All-purpose flour has a higher gluten content. Therefore, it’s the right choice for bread and other recipes where the dough needs to rise.

Wheat Pastry Flour works much better for non-rising recipes; it gives your baked goods the delightfully soft and flaky texture by default.


When to Use Soft Wheat Pastry Flour

Sifted Wheat Flour is best used for pie crusts, homemade pasta, cookies, and croissants. You can also use it to make delicious blueberry muffins and cranberry scones. The idea is to use this type of flour when you want the pastries to be soft and fluffy in texture.

Note that soft wheat flour is rather tasteless. Therefore, it’s convenient that it can be used in almost any recipe. We find it works amazingly to make the batter for fried dishes.

How to Prepare the Dough
Preparing the dough is an easy process:
– Pour 2 ½ cups of water into a container.
– Add salt and gradually mix in 2 ½ cups of corn meal.
– Briefly knead the mixture until a smooth dough is formed and then let it rest for 3 minutes.

How to Prepare Arepas
Separate dough in 10 pieces. Take one portion in your hands and shape it into a ball, then press it with your palms to form a large patty shape of about 10 cm
or 3 ½ inches in diameter. Place onto a griddle or frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until brown on both sides, and serve hot.
Open the arepa and fill it with cheese, ham, eggs, salad or anything else you might put in a sandwich.

It was thus that it came be called P.A.N., acronym for Productos Alimenticios Nacionales.

On December 10, 1960 P.A.N. was launched and achieved great success, from a complete satisfaction of the Venezuelan consumer.

Einkorn is sourced from organic farms in the USA. Azure Standard’s Unifine flour is milled at the Azure Farm Mill in Dufur, Ore., one of only a few such mills in the world, and family owned. The name “Unifine” comes from the milling process itself, where it takes just one step (uni) to produce a very fine, uniform consistency, while also preserving the natural nutrients of the grain. With Unifine Milling, the grain enters a high speed rotor with a single-pass impact system that instantly pulverizes the kernels with little heat involved, bursting into fine flour at a cool temperature. With this unique, one-step milling process the entire bran, germ and endosperm of the grain are retained, resulting in superior nutritious flour, and the oil molecules are left intact resulting in a longer shelf life. Ultimately, Unifine milled flours from Azure are packed with many times the nutritional value compared with commercially milled flours. It has almost four times as much dietary fiber, more than twice as much potassium, and three times the magnesium. Whole grain Unifine Flours require the baker to use significantly more water than commercial white flours or other milled brands. With germ and bran intact, there should be less mixing or kneading, and longer time allowed for fermentation and rising. Baking with organic whole grain flours may take some practice and experimentation, but the resulting nutrition and superior taste are worth it.

description:
Enjoy baking even more with the help of Organic Millet Flour. It will add more flavor and texture to your bread, muffins, and cookies. It’s naturally gluten-free and can be a great addition to various flour mixes.

Stone-ground hulled millet makes Organic Millet Flour, and it means that this flour retains a lot of the precious nutrients. Millet is rich in calcium, iron, and B vitamins by nature. It’s also high in protein and fiber.

People suffering from thyroid issues might want to consider and consult a family doctor before consuming millet daily. There is always a way to include it in your meal plan safely.


How to Bake with Organic Millet Flour

You can add millet flour to any gluten-free flour mix. Play around with ratios to test how it works for your recipes. Millet flour adds texture to dough and works well with sorghum flour, in particular.

Millet has a mildly-nutty and buttery flavor, which is enhanced by heating. Therefore, it will add a pleasant taste to all your baked goods.

If you don’t require flour to be gluten-free, you can mix millet with regular all-purpose flour, though be prepared to make some adjustments to the recipe as this product coarser and has more of a meal-type texture.

When using with all-purpose flour, replace ½ cup of it in the recipe with millet flour. It will result in the volume of the final baked product going down by 15% to 20%, so don’t be alarmed, the texture of the product itself will be crumbly and lovely.

Note that you also shouldn’t use more than 20% of millet flour in flour mixes for muffins, it might give your treats a slightly starchy taste.

You can also sprinkle millet flour on bread and buns before baking to make a more delicious golden crust.

description:

Rye contains many proteins and amino acids, so even athletes can benefit from it in their diet.
How does it taste and how can you use it

Rye flour possesses a unique taste and color. The taste is slightly bitter and nutty, which is surprising for those who like wheat bread.
Another quality of rye flour is its ability to become brown when baked. That is why the crumb of rye bread is always dark.
For a long time, whole rye flour was only for industrial baking of bread. However, nowadays, it is becoming more common, and the number of recipes with rye flour continuously grows. You can make cookies, pancakes, pies, tortillas, and other goodies from it. Different mixing proportions - different properties of your bread
Because bread flour possesses different characteristics than wheat flour, it is rarely used as a substitute. Instead, bakers use it to make a flour mix. Here are some examples of bread with the use of different proportions of rye and wheat flours:
The bread that has up to 40% rye flour, commonly referred to as "rye bread." Rye flour is in a reasonably large proportion here; therefore, there is a distinct rye flavor.
Bread with more than 50% rye flour is entirely different. All the unique characteristics of rye and wheat's chemical differences become more important as the proportion of rye in the dough increases. Typically this bread is flatter and should be allowed to rest for a few hours after baking to prevent crusting.
When there is 70% rye or more, the bread may need to rest for 24 hours, even up to several days, before slicing.

description:
Corn flour is a type of flour that's milled from dried whole corn kernels. It contains the hull and endosperm of the corn and is considered a whole grain flour.
Corn flour is usually yellow, but it can also be white or blue depending on the variety of corn it uses. The texture is fine and smooth, similar to whole wheat flour.
Like all flours, corn flour gives structure to baked goods and other foods. It's often combined with a binder like eggs to provide shape. Corn flour doesn't taste very good raw, but cooking—whether it's baking, frying, or grilling—unlocks its earthy, sweet flavor.
Corn flour is extremely versatile, and you can incorporate it into recipes for breads, muffins, waffles, pancakes, battered and fried foods, blinis, and more.
Corn flour is often overshadowed by its grittier cousin: cornmeal. You've probably spotted corn flour in the baking aisle of the grocery store, but you may not have known what to do with it. As it turns out, there are plenty of reasons to stock your pantry with this ultra-fine flour.

description: Organic Kamut Unifine Flour is milled from grain considered part of the "ancient grains" category, and more nutritious than regular wheat due to a higher protein and potassium content. It also contains a unique type of gluten that is said to be easier to digest than common wheat gluten. Kamut flour, which is yellow rather than light brown, can be used for bread, muffins and other baked goods as well as for homemade pasta. It has a rich "buttery" taste, high nutritional value and is also easy to digest. All natural, no preservatives or additives, no bleaching or enriching. Kamut is sourced from organic farms in the USA Azure Standard’s Unifine flour is milled at the Azure Farm Mill in Dufur, Ore., one of only a few such mills in the world, and family owned. The name “Unifine” comes from the milling process itself, where it takes just one step (uni) to produce a very fine, uniform consistency, while also preserving the natural nutrients of the grain. With Unifine Milling, the grain enters a high speed rotor with a single-pass impact system that instantly pulverizes the kernels with little heat involved, bursting into fine flour at a cool temperature. With this unique, one-step milling process the entire bran, germ and endosperm of the grain are retained, resulting in superior nutritious flour, and the oil molecules are left intact resulting in a longer shelf life. Ultimately, Unifine milled flours from Azure are packed with many times the nutritional value compared with commercially milled flours. It has almost four times as much dietary fiber, more than twice as much potassium, and three times the magnesium. Whole grain Unifine Flours require the baker to use significantly more water than commercial white flours or other milled brands. With germ and bran intact, there should be less mixing or kneading, and longer time allowed for fermentation and rising.

How to Prepare the Dough
Preparing the dough is an easy process:
– Pour 2 ½ cups of water into a container.
– Add salt and gradually mix in 2 ½ cups of corn meal.
– Briefly knead the mixture until a smooth dough is formed and then let it rest for 3 minutes.

How to Prepare Arepas
Separate dough in 10 pieces. Take one portion in your hands and shape it into a ball, then press it with your palms to form a large patty shape of about 10 cm
or 3 ½ inches in diameter. Place onto a griddle or frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until brown on both sides, and serve hot.
Open the arepa and fill it with cheese, ham, eggs, salad or anything else you might put in a sandwich.

description:
Glutinous Rice Flour is also known as sweet rice flour or sweet rice powder, this flour is made from short-grain rice that becomes moist, firm and sticky when cooked, a result of its higher proportion of waxy starch molecules.

Red Bean Mochi Recipe
Mochi is one of our family’s favourite desserts which is a Japanese rice cake made of glutinous rice. One of the many Japanese confections such as daifuku, that is mochi stuffed with sweet fillings, like sweetened red bean paste, is very popular around the world. You can stuff any other sweet fillings you like in mochi. No wonder mochi is widely welcome by different people with different tastes.

220 gm glutinous rice flour 
110 gm sugar 
200 ml coconut milk (or milk) 
desiccated coconut (or fried glutinous rice flour) to coat mochi 
Red bean paste ingredients:

1/2 cup red beans 
1 1/2 cup water 
rock sugar to taste 


Combine glutinous rice flour with sugar well. Gradually stir in coconut milk (or milk) until smooth. 
Transfer flour mixture in a greased shallow plate (see picture 1), steam over high heat with cover for 30 minutes, or until cooked through (see picture 2). Use a chop stick to test if it’s cooked. If not much flour mixture sticks to the chop stick, it’s done. Let cool down a bit until you don’t feel too hot to handle. 
Transfer to a greased surface. Cut into 12 even small portions. Knead each into a small disc. Spoon red bean paste in the middle (see picture 3). Fold the edge to seal the mochi. Lightly roll it into a ball shape using both palms, then coat with desiccated coconut. The alternative way to coat mochi is to use cooked glutinous rice flour. Fry some extra glutinous rice flour on a non-stick frying-pan over medium-low heat without any oil. Let it cook for 3 minutes until aromatic. Don’t let it burn by all means. After the cooked flour cools down a bit, you can use it to coat mochi.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. description:
When a seed is planted in the ground it grows from the roots down. It is with that much intention that we get connected to our ancient roots and bring protein-rich grains from farmland to table. Freekeh is an ancient grain rooted in the Middle Eastern tradition of roasting young green wheat.

The roasted grain has a nutty flavor and chewy texture that provider innovative meal options that are in demand.

Freekeh has a chewy texture and a nutty flavor that resonates with the plant-based foodie because Freekeh is a nutrient dense ancient grain. Freekeh is a good source of protein (6g per 40g serving) and fiber (4g per 40g serving) making it more nutritious than brown rice, bulgur, and similar grains.


When to Use Freekeh?

Freekeh is a versatile super grain that cooks perfectly in soups, pilafs, salads, stir-fries and stews, or can be stone ground into flour for baking purposes. Whether you are looking for plant-based vegetarian or vegan option, or to feature a unique grain in your culinary masterpieces; Freekeh is the smart choice.


How is Freekeh Cooked and Enjoyed?

Freekeh cooks like rice. Freekeh has a chewy texture that holds its tooth, even after a couple days in the refrigerator – it will not congeal like rice or quinoa when stored after cooking.

Freekeh is available in two varieties: cracked or whole.

description:
HATTON HILL ORGANIC POLENTA (GLUTEN FREE)

One of the many Italian staple foods that have conquered the world, polenta is coarsely ground cornmeal typically used as a flavoursome base or an accompaniment for a wide range of other foods.

Its name derives from Latin, which gives you some idea of its long history. Corn – naturally, gluten-free, and from which it is milled – is believed to have been the most important food crop throughout the ancient Americas.

PURE & PREMIUM PRODUCT:

Hatton Hill Organic’s polenta is grown in the Italian sunshine, where it is dried and milled to seal in its fresh, summery flavour.

USES:

Polenta is a superb substitute for potatoes or pasta and is typically simmered like porridge to cook – often in broth or herby stock preparations to impart additional flavour. From thereon out, it is up to you how to use this versatile ingredient!

At its simplest, it forms a creamy, tasty and nutritious base for meat, fish, poultry and vegetable dishes such as ragouts and stews, but it can also be left to cool and dry, enabling it to be sliced like bread and – if you want to give it a nice finishing touch – baked, grilled, or pan-fried.

And it does not stop there! Polenta can be used like flour in baking, and like breadcrumbs to coat chicken or fish. Or how about in place of porridge or cereal for a smooth and satisfying breakfast, topped with yoghurt or fruit?

Organic Polenta (Gluten Free) by Hatton Hill Organic. Milled from premium-grade corn organically grown, harvested and dried in Italy. Packed in the UK.

To make it, bring 3 cups of water and 1/4 teaspoon of salt to a boil, then add 1 cup of Bob's Red Mill grits and reduce the heat. Cook it slowly for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, then cover, remove from heat, and let stand for a few minutes before serving! This easy-to-prepare product is sure to become a favorite! Polenta was originally eaten as a staple food by subsistence farmers, but eventually evolved into a flavorful dish prepared with aromatics that is arguably as quintessentially Italian as pasta! Try preparing polenta and serving it with marinara sauce and grated Parmesan cheese for a simple, flavorful, and satisfying meal. bullet_point: [GLUTEN-FREE WHEAT FLOUR SUBSTITUTE: Organic Cassava Flour is a fantastic substitute for wheat flour and contains no gluten whatsoever., REPLACEMENT FOR ALL-PURPOSE FLOUR: When baking with cassava flour, you will get the same kind of fluffy baked goods as you would with white wheat flour., FINE POWDER TEXTURE: Organic cassava flour isn’t gritty or chunky like the majority of other gluten-free flours., DELICIOUS NUTTY FLAVOR: Cassava flour has a very mild but pleasant nutty flavor that can enhance the taste of your baked goods., FULL OF FIBER: Organic cassava flour goes through minimal processing, so it retains many of the root’s natural nutrients, including fiber.]
description: With Organic Cassava Flour you can enjoy delicious cakes, buns, and other goodies with soft and fluffy texture even if you are gluten-intolerant. This is the closest gluten-free substitute for wheat flour that won’t alter the texture of your baked goods in any significant way. Also, it will enrich those treats with fiber and some trace amounts of essential vitamins and minerals. Organic Cassava Flour also has a delicious, if mild, nutty flavor. This adds another dimension to your baking making it easier for you to create true masterpieces that are 100% gluten-free. It’s made from dried and pulverized cassava root and has a very fine texture. How to Use Organic Cassava Flour When Baking. The best thing about Organic Cassava Flour is that this product can literally substitute all-purpose flour in a recipe without any additions. Unlike other types of gluten-free flours, this one is nearly identical to wheat in texture and chemical properties, so it acts the same when you add it to the dough. The only small difference is that it absorbs water a bit better. That’s why you should first have a few test runs with your baking recipes. The similarities between wheat and cassava flour mean that the baked goods will have a nearly identical texture as well. This won’t be the case if you use any other type of gluten-free flour as none other can fluff up the dough right. Organic Cassava Flour Vs/ Tapioca: Are They the Same? Do not mistake cassava flour for tapioca because despite coming from the same plant, these are two distinctly different products. Organic Cassava Flour is exactly that, it’s a flour made from whole cassava root. This means that it contains the fiber and other nutrients from the original plant. Tapioca, however, is starch derived from cassava root. As it’s starch only, it has no taste, very few nutrients, and its texture and chemical properties aren’t the same.
