description:
Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

Great River Organic Milling se encuentra en la parte superior del río Mississippi, en el corazón de lo que se llama el Valle de Hiawatha. La belleza natural de la zona es un recordatorio constante de la importancia de nuestro compromiso con la agricultura orgánica. La agricultura orgánica o sostenible es más que la evitación de fertilizantes químicos y pesticidas. Una granja orgánica se esfuerza por proteger nuestro medio ambiente mediante la construcción y el mantenimiento de suelos saludables que, a su vez, mejora la calidad del agua y del aire. Se ha demostrado que los granos y otros cultivos alimenticios cultivados en un suelo saludable, resisten mejor a las plagas y enfermedades que los cultivos cultivados convencionalmente y también contienen nutrientes más vitales importantes para los seres humanos. El consumo de alimentos orgánicos promueve la salud de las personas y la tierra en la que se cultivó. Al apoyar la agricultura orgánica promovemos el ciclo de un ambiente saludable que incluye la vida de microorganismos, plantas y humanos. La mayor parte de la harina del Gran Río es de piedra molida. Creemos que las piedras de molino de granito natural contribuyen a la calidad, el sabor y la integridad nutricional de la harina de grano entero. El grano que fluye en las piedras se vuelve muy delgado, copos planos que integra todas las partes del trigo inmediatamente en la harina, permitiendo que la harina tenga más sabor. Las temperaturas más frías que se producen durante el fresado con piedras permiten que continúe la actividad enzimática importante. También se mantienen los niveles de proteínas. Nuestras harinas molidas de piedra se molen a pedido, para conservar el valor nutricional de la harina. Great River está certificado orgánico por Quality Assurance International y Kosher aprobado. La obtención de nuestra certificación requiere una inspección anual de nuestras instalaciones de fresado y registros para asegurar que nuestros productos cumplan con los estándares de la industria.

טחינה אורגנית של Great River ממוקמת על נהר מיסיסיפי העליון, בלב מה שנקרא עמק Hiawatha. היופי הטבעי של האזור הוא תזכורת מתמדת לחשיבות המחויבות שלנו לחקלאות אורגנית. חקלאות אורגנית או בת קיימא היא יותר מאשר הימנעות מדשנים כימיים וחומרי הדברה. חווה אורגנית שואפת להגן על הסביבה שלנו על ידי בנייה ושמירה על קרקע בריאה, אשר, בתורו, משפר את איכות המים והאוויר. הוכח כי דגנים וגידולי מזון אחרים הגדלים באדמה בריאה, עמידים בפני מזיקים ומחלות טוב יותר מאשר יבולים שגדלו באופן רגיל וגם מכילים יותר חומרים מזינים חשובים לבני אדם. צריכת מזון אורגני מקדמת את בריאותם של אנשים ואת הארץ שעליה גדלה. בתמיכה בחקלאות אורגנית אנו מקדמים את מחזור הסביבה הבריאה הכוללת את חייהם של מיקרואורגניזמים, צמחים ובני אדם. קמח הנהר הגדול ביותר הוא קרקע אבן. אנו מאמינים שאבני הרחיים הגרניט הטבעיים תורמים לאיכות, לטעם ולשלמות התזונתית של קמח דגנים מלאים. גרגרים הזורמים לתוך האבנים הופכים לדקים מאוד, פתיתים שטוחים המשלבים את כל חלקי החיטה מיד לתוך הקמח, ומאפשרים לקמח להיות יותר טעם. הטמפרטורות הקרירות המתרחשות במהלך טחינה עם אבנים מאפשרות פעילות אנזים חשובה להמשיך. גם רמות חלבון נשמרות ברמות. הקמחים שלנו טחונים לפי הזמנה, כדי לשמור על הערך התזונתי של הקמח. Great River מוסמך אורגני על ידי בקרת איכות בינלאומית ומאושר כשרות. קבלת האישורים שלנו דורשת בדיקה שנתית של מתקן הטחינה והרשומות שלנו כדי להבטיח שהמוצרים שלנו עומדים בסטנדרטים של התעשייה.

Great River Organic Milling befindet sich am oberen Mississippi Fluss, im Herzen des Hiawatha Valley. Die natürliche Schönheit der Gegend erinnert immer an die Bedeutung unseres Engagements für die biologische Landwirtschaft. Die biologische oder nachhaltige Landwirtschaft ist mehr als die Vermeidung von chemischen Düngemitteln und Pestiziden. Eine Bio-Farm strebt danach, unsere Umwelt zu schützen, indem sie einen gesunden Boden aufbauen und pflegen, der wiederum die Wasser- und Luftqualität verbessert. Es wurde gezeigt, dass Getreide und andere Lebensmittelpflanzen, die in einem gesunden Boden angebaut werden, Schädlingen und Krankheiten besser widerstehen als konventionell gewachsene Kulturen und auch mehr lebenswichtige Nährstoffe enthalten, die für den Menschen wichtig sind. Der Verzehr von biologischen Lebensmitteln fördert die Gesundheit der Menschen und das Land, auf dem es angebaut wurde. Zur Unterstützung der biologischen Landwirtschaft fördern wir den Kreislauf einer gesunden Umwelt, die das Leben von Mikroorganismen, Pflanzen und Menschen umfasst. Most Great River Mehl ist steingemahlen. Wir glauben, dass die natürlichen Granitmühlsteine zur Qualität, Geschmack und Nährstoffintegrität von Vollkornmehl beitragen. Getreide, das in die Steine fließt, werden sehr dünne, flache Flocken, die alle Teile des Weizens sofort in das Mehl integrieren, sodass das Mehl mehr Geschmack hat. Die kühleren Temperaturen, die beim Fräsen mit Steinen auftreten, lassen wichtige Enzymaktivität fortsetzen. Auch der Proteinspiegel wird beibehalten. Unsere steingemahlenen Mehle werden auf Bestellung gemahlen, um den Nährwert des Mehls zu erhalten. Great River ist organisch zertifiziert durch Qualitätssicherung International und koscher genehmigt. Die Erhaltung unserer Zertifizierung erfordert eine jährliche Inspektion unserer Fräsanlage und Aufzeichnungen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produkte den Industriestandards entsprechen.

تقع جريت ريفر أورجانيك ميللينغ على نهر ميسيسيبي، في قلب ما يُسمى وادي هاواثا. الجمال الطبيعي للمنطقة هو تذكير دائم بأهمية التزامنا بالزراعة العضوية. الزراعة العضوية أو المستدامة أكثر من تجنب الأسمدة الكيميائية والمبيدات الحشرية. تسعى مزرعة عضوية لحماية بيئتنا من خلال بناء والحفاظ على تربة صحية والتي تعمل بدورها على تحسين جودة المياه والهواء. لقد ثبت أن الحبوب والمحاصيل الأخرى الغذائية تنمو في تربة صحية وتقاوم الآفات والأمراض بشكل أفضل من المحاصيل المزروعة تقليديًا وتحتوي أيضًا على مغذيات حيوية أكثر أهمية للبشر. استهلاك الأطعمة العضوية يعزز صحة الأفراد والأرض التي تنمو عليها. من خلال دعم الزراعة العضوية، فإننا نعزز دورة البيئة الصحية التي تشمل حياة الكائنات الحية الدقيقة والنباتات والبشر. معظم طحين نهر جريت ريفر مطحون بالحجر. نحن نؤمن بأن أحجار الجرانيت الطبيعية تساهم في جودة الطحين والطعم والسلامة الغذائية الكاملة. تصبح الحبوب التي تتدفق إلى الأحجار رقيقة جدًا، ورقائق مسطحة تدمج جميع أجزاء القمح على الفور في الطحين، مما يسمح للدقيق بالحصول على المزيد من النكهة. تسمح درجات الحرارة الأكثر برودة التي تحدث أثناء الطحن بالحجارة بالاستمرار في نشاط الإنزيم المهم. كما يتم الحفاظ على مستويات البروتين. الطحين الحجري المطحون لدينا يتم طحنه حسب الطلب، للحفاظ على القيمة الغذائية للطحين. منتج جريت ريفر عضوي معتمد من مؤسسة ضمان الجودة الدولية ومعتمد من الشريعة اليهودية. يتطلب الحصول على شهادتنا فحصًا سنوياً لمنشأة الطحن وسجلات للتأكد من أن منتجاتنا تلبي المعايير الصناعية.

A Great River Organic Milling está localizada no alto rio Mississippi, no coração do que é chamado de Vale Hiawatha. A beleza natural da região é um lembrete constante da importância do nosso compromisso com a agricultura orgânica. Agricultura orgânica ou sustentável é mais do que evitar adubos químicos e pesticidas. Uma fazenda orgânica se esforça para proteger o nosso meio ambiente, construindo e mantendo solo saudável que, por sua vez, melhora a qualidade da água e do ar. Foi mostrado que grãos e outras culturas alimentares cultivadas em um solo saudável, resistem a pragas e doenças melhor do que culturas convencionais e também contêm nutrientes mais vitais importantes para os seres humanos. Consumir alimentos orgânicos promove a saúde das pessoas e a terra em que foi cultivada. Ao apoiar a agricultura orgânica, promovemos o ciclo de um ambiente saudável que inclui a vida de microrganismos, plantas e seres humanos. A farinha de Great River é moída em pedra. Acreditamos que as pedras de granito naturais contribuem para a qualidade, sabor e integridade nutricional da farinha de flor integral. O grão que flui nas pedras torna-se muito fino e plano, que integra todas as partes do trigo imediatamente à farinha, permitindo que a farinha tenha mais sabor. As temperaturas mais frias que ocorrem durante a moagem com pedras permitem que a atividade enzimática importante continue. Os níveis de proteína também são mantidos. Nossas farinhas moídas em pedra são moídas sob encomenda, para reter o valor nutricional da farinha. Great River é certificado orgânico pela Quality Assurance International e aprovado pela Kosher. 그레이트 리버 오가닉 밀링은 히아와타 계곡이라고 불리는 중심부 미시피 강 위쪽에 위치해 있습니다. 이 지역의 자연스러운 아름다움은 유기농 농업에 대한 당사의 헌신의 중요성을 지속적으로 상기시킵니다. 유기농이거나 지속 가능한 농업은 화학 비료 및 살충제를 피하는 것 이상입니다. 유기농 농장은 물과 공기 품질을 향상시키는 건강한 토양을 만들고 유지하여 환경을 보호하기 위해 노력합니다. 건강한 토양에서 자란 곡물 및 기타 식품 작물은 기존의 재배된 작물보다 해충과 질병에 저항하며 인간에게 중요한 영양소를 더 많이 함유하고 있다는 것이 밝혀졌습니다. 유기농 식품을 섭취하면 개인과 성장한 땅의 건강을 증진시킵니다. 유기농 농업을 지원하는 데 있어 미생물, 식물 및 인간의 삶을 포함한 건강한 환경의 사이클을 촉진합니다. 대부분의 그레이트 리버 밀가루는 돌로 갈아 만들었습니다. 저희는 천연 화강암 맷돌이 통곡물 가루의 품질, 맛 및 영양 무결성에 기여한다고 믿습니다. 돌로 흐르는 곡물은 매우 얇고 평평한 조각이 되어 밀의 모든 부분을 밀가루에 즉시 통합하여 밀가루에 더 많은 맛을 낼 수 있습니다. 스톤으로 밀링 중에 발생하는 더 차가운 온도는 중요한 효소 활동을 계속할 수 있게 합니다. 단백질 수준도 유지됩니다. 당사의 석재 분쇄 가루는 밀가루의 영양 가치를 유지하기 위해 주문에 따라 가공됩니다. Great River는 국제 품질 보증 및 코셔 승인을 받은 유기농 인증을 받았습니다. 인증을 획득하려면 당사의 밀링 시설과 기록을 매년 검사하여 제품이 업계 표준을 충족하는지 확인해야 합니다.

Wonderful for gluten free baking, organic white Rice flour results in light and fluffy cakes, pie crusts, and breads. It is also great for thickening sauces, gravies, and soups. Stone-ground on our slow-turning millstones for a fine consistency ideal for baking. Like all our gluten free-labeled products, this product is manufactured in a dedicated gluten free facility and R5-ELISA tested to confirm its gluten free status. Certified Organic by QAI.

קמח אורז לבן אורגני של Bob's Red Mill הוא באמת מרכיב עיקרי לכל מזווה ללא גלוטן. נהדר לאפייה ללא גלוטן, קמח אורז לבן אורגני מביא לעוגות קלות ואווריריות, קרומי פאי ולחמים. נהדר גם לעיבוי רטבים, רטבים ומרקים. אבן טחונה על אבני הרחיים המסתובבות לאט שלנו לקבלת עקביות עדינה אידאלית לאפייה. כמו כל המוצרים שלנו ללא גלוטן, מוצר זה מיוצר במתקן ייעודי ללא גלוטן ונבדק R5-ELISA כדי לאשר את מצב ללא גלוטן. מוסמך אורגני על ידי QAI.

Bob's Red Mill Bio-Reismehl ist wirklich ein Grundstück für jede glutenfreie Speisekammer. Wunderbar für glutenfreies Backen, organisches weißes Reismehl ergibt leichte und flauschige Kuchen, Kuchenkrusten und Brot. Es ist auch ideal zum Verdichten von Saucen, Soßen und Suppen. Steingemahlen auf unseren langsam drehenden Mühlsteinen für eine feine Konsistenz, ideal zum Backen. Wie alle unsere glutenfreien Produkte wird dieses Produkt in einer engagierten glutenfreien Anlage hergestellt und R5-ELISA getestet, um seinen glutenfreien Status zu bestätigen. Zertifiziert biologisch durch QAI.

دقيق الأرز الأبيض العضوي من بوبس ريد ميل هو حقًا عنصر أساسي لأي مخزن خالٍ من الغلوتين. رائعة للخبز الخالي من الغلوتين، وطحين الأرز الأبيض العضوي يؤدي إلى كعكة خفيفة وزغبة وفطائر وخبز. كما أنه رائع لتكثيف الصلصات والمرق والحساء حجري على حجر الأحجار بطيئة الدوران للحصول على قوام دقيق مثالي للخبز. مثل جميع منتجاتنا الخالية من الغلوتين، يتم تصنيع هذا المنتج في منشأة مخصصة خالية من الغلوتين وتم اختبارها R5-ELISA للتأكد من حالتها الخالية من الغلوتين. عضوي معتمد من QAI.

A farinha de arroz branco orgânico da Bob's Red Mill é realmente um item básico para qualquer despensa sem glúten. Maravilhoso para assar sem glúten, farinha de arroz branco orgânico resulta em bolos leves e fofos, crostas de torta e pães. Também é ótimo para espessar molhos, molhos e sopas. Moído em pedra em nossas pedras de giro lento para uma consistência fina ideal para assar. Como todos os nossos produtos sem glúten, este produto é fabricado em uma instalação dedicada sem glúten e testado para R5-Elisa para confirmar seu status sem glúten. Certificado orgânico pela QAI.

Bob's Red Mill 有机白米粉是所有无麸质食品柜的主食。 非常适合无麸质烘烤,有机白米粉会产生淡淡而蓬松的蛋糕、馅饼皮和面包。 也适合用于酱汁、肉汁和汤汁的增稠。 慢转磨石磨石板提供优良的一致性,适合烘焙。 像我们所有的无麸质标签产品一样,该产品在专用的无麸质工厂生产,经过R5-ELISA测试以确认其无麸质状态。 QAI有机认证。

Bob's Red Mill 有機白米粉是任何無麩質食品室的真正主食。 非常適合無麩質烘焙,有機白米粉可產生輕盈蓬鬆的蛋糕、餡餅和麵包。 也適合加厚的醬料、肉汁和湯。 在我們的慢速轉動的磨石上磨石,具有完美的一致性,非常適合烘焙。 與我們所有的無麩質標籤產品一樣,本產品在專門的無麩質工廠製造,並經過 R5-ELISA 測試,以確認其無麩質狀態。 由 QAI 有機認證。

description:
Make original and tasty Latin-American and Caribbean food in your kitchen with PAN Sweetcorn Mix. It simplifies the preparation of corn-based food
while preserving its delicious flavor. The P.A.N. Sweetcorn Mix is made with tender sweetcorn, giving you the perfect mix for your corn recipes.
Prepare cachapas or arepas de choclo, corn flatbread, sweetcorn bread, sweet buns, sweetcorn croquettes, stuffed rolls and much more.

How to prepare Cachapas

– 1 cup P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix
– 1 ¼ cups water
– ¼ cup milk
– 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
– Shortening or vegetable oil to grease the pan

PREPARATION

1. Pour water, milk and oil into a bowl. Slowly add P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix and stir until homogeneous. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
2. Pour a portion of the batter with a ladle on a greased hot pan or griddle and spread it to make 5-6 inch wide discs.
3. Cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
4. Side with butter and fresh white cheese, or any other filling of your choice.

How to Use Organic Whole Wheat Flour for Bread Baking

In essence, you can add some organic white whole wheat flour to any bread recipe. Replace a portion of the all-purpose flour in the recipe with this product.

How to Prepare the Dough
Preparing the dough is an easy process:
– Pour 2 ½ cups of water into a container.
– Add salt and gradually mix in 2 ½ cups of corn meal.
– Briefly knead the mixture until a smooth dough is formed and then let it rest for 3 minutes.

How to Prepare Arepas
Separate dough in 10 pieces. Take one portion in your hands and shape it into a ball, then press it with your palms to form a large patty shape of about 10 cm
or 3 ½ inches in diameter. Place onto a griddle or frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until brown on both sides, and serve hot.
Open the arepa and fill it with cheese, ham, eggs, salad or anything else you might put in a sandwich.

It was thus that it came be called P.A.N., acronym for Productos Alimenticios Nacionales.

On December 10, 1960 P.A.N. was launched and achieved great success, from a complete satisfaction of the Venezuelan consumer.

Today, with 58 years of tradition, P.A.N. is found in more than 60 countries, bringing the delicious flavor of corn to consumers in an easy and practical way
to prepare their favorite corn based recipes.

Como preparar a massa
Preparar a massa é um processo fácil:
– Coloque 2 ½ xícaras de água em um recipiente.
– Adicione sal e misture gradualmente em 2 xícaras de farinha de milho.
– amasse rapidamente a mistura até formar uma massa lisa e depois deixe descansar por 3 minutos.

Como preparar as áreas
Separe a massa em 10 peças. Pegue uma porção em suas mãos e molde-a em uma bola, depois pressione com as palmas das mãos para formar uma forma grande de cerca de 10 cm.
ou 8,5 cm de diâmetro. Coloque em uma grelha ou frigideira em temperatura média por 5 minutos de cada lado, ou até marrom em ambos os lados, e sirva quente.
Abra a arena e encha com queijo, presunto, ovos, salada ou qualquer outra coisa que você possa colocar em um sanduíche.

description:
Organic buckwheat kernels are usually considered whole grains, but they are actually seeds. As pseudo-grains, they are much easier to digest and are generally healthier than grains. Organic kasha is actually hulled and roasted buckwheat kernels. The taste of organic buckwheat is rich, a little bit nutty. As it’s much more flavorful than many whole grains, you can use it as a substitute in recipes. The main organic buckwheat benefits come from the fact that it’s nutritious and low in calories. This combination makes it a perfect choice for a weight management diet. Many athletes also love organic kasha because it gives them protein and fiber without fat. Buckwheat nutrition value is rather high compared to whole grains. One cup of cooked organic kasha will provide you with: - B vitamins - Vitamin K - Vitamin E - Calcium - Manganese - Phosphorus - Magnesium - Zinc - Iron - Copper - Selenium One of the great things about organic buckwheat kernels is that you don’t have to pre-soak them before cooking. Of course, you can do this, but they soak up water so effectively that in a few hours groats will be all but cooked even before you turn on the heat. This will make them mushy by the time you are actually finished cooking. You can enjoy organic kasha in many ways. Use it as a breakfast cereal or as an ingredient in a delicious main dish, cooked pilaf-style. You can mill grains into buckwheat flour and enjoy making organic buckwheat crepes and pancakes. They taste incredible and are lower in calories than wheat products. Organic buckwheat kernels are also safe to use in any gluten-free baking project.

description:
Enjoy baking even more with the help of Organic Millet Flour. It will add more flavor and texture to your bread, muffins, and cookies. It’s naturally gluten-free and can be a great addition to various flour mixes.

Stone-ground hulled millet makes Organic Millet Flour, and it means that this flour retains a lot of the precious nutrients. Millet is rich in calcium, iron, and B vitamins by nature. It’s also high in protein and fiber.

People suffering from thyroid issues might want to consider and consult a family doctor before consuming millet daily. There is always a way to include it in your meal plan safely.


How to Bake with Organic Millet Flour

You can add millet flour to any gluten-free flour mix. Play around with ratios to test how it works for your recipes. Millet flour adds texture to dough and works well with sorghum flour, in particular.

Millet has a mildly-nutty and buttery flavor, which is enhanced by heating. Therefore, it will add a pleasant taste to all your baked goods.

If you don’t require flour to be gluten-free, you can mix millet with regular all-purpose flour, though be prepared to make some adjustments to the recipe as this product coarser and has more of a meal-type texture.

When using with all-purpose flour, replace ½ cup of it in the recipe with millet flour. It will result in the volume of the final baked product going down by 15% to 20%, so don’t be alarmed, the texture of the product itself will be crumbly and lovely.

Note that you also shouldn’t use more than 20% of millet flour in flour mixes for muffins, it might give your treats a slightly starchy taste.

You can also sprinkle millet flour on bread and buns before baking to make a more delicious golden crust.

description: Neapolitan pizza dough Makes 48 ounces dough or five 9.5-ounce portions, enough for five 9-inch pizzas INGREDIENTS: 1/2 teaspoon (3 grams) fresh cake yeast 2 cups lukewarm water (90° to 100°F) 1 tablespoon table salt or fine sea salt 2 lbs/910 g Caputo flour plus more for dusting INSTRUCTIONS: In a small bowl, using a fork, stir the yeast into 1 cup of the lukewarm water. Set aside until the yeast dissolves, about 5 minutes. In another small bowl, combine the salt and remaining 1 cup water. Stir to dissolve the salt. To make the dough by hand: Place 7 1/4 cups (2 pounds) of the flour in a large bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour and stir in the yeast mixture, along with the saltwater mixture. Using a wooden spoon, mix the dough, incorporating as much of the flour as possible. Turn the dough out on a lightly floured work surface and knead until soft and elastic, 12 to 15 minutes. It will still be a little sticky but shouldn’t stick to your hands. Add only a minimum amount of flour to the work surface to keep the dough from sticking. To prepare the dough for rising: Cut the dough into fifths to form five even portions, each weighing 9.5 ounces. Pick up one portion of dough and pull the opposite edges together, wrapping them underneath towards the center to form a tight, smooth ball. Pinch to seal. Repeat with the other four portions. Place each portion in a 1-gallon lock-top plastic bag. Squeeze out all the air and seal the bag, allowing enough room for the dough to double in size. Let rise in a cool room (about 60°F) for 6 to 8 hours. Alternatively, refrigerate for at least 10 hours or up to 24 hours. Remove from the refrigerator 3 hours before using to allow the dough to come to room temperature. Proceed with any Neapolitan pizza recipe.

description:

Prepare cachapas or arepas de choclo, corn flatbread, sweetcorn bread, sweet buns, sweetcorn croquettes, stuffed rolls and much more.

How to prepare Cachapas

– 1 cup P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix
– 1 ¼ cups water
– ¼ cup milk
– 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
– Shortening or vegetable oil to grease the pan

PREPARATION

1. Pour water, milk and oil into a bowl. Slowly add P.A.N. Sweet Corn Mix and stir until homogeneous. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
2. Pour a portion of the batter with a ladle on a greased hot pan or griddle and spread it to make 5-6 inch wide discs.
3. Cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
4. Side with butter and fresh white cheese, or any other filling of your choice.

description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

Sprouted wheat is best served for breakfast. Sprouted wheat berries can be consumed both in whole and in a chopped form (chopped in a blender). You can add whole grains of germinated wheat to various salads, soups, side dishes. Shredded sprouted wheat can be used to make healthy cereal and bake bread.


Wheatgrass

Wheatgrass is prepared by sprouting wheat seeds in water for 7-10 days before harvesting the leaves. Eating raw wheatgrass is more useful than eating cooked wheatgrass as the enzymes responsible for detoxifying the body are thought to be deactivated by cooking foods.

Nutritional info:
Chlorophyll
Vitamins A, C, E, K and B-complex
Iron
Calcium

Selenium
Amino acids

description:

Then again "white flour" is now exclusively used to identify wheat so maybe the marketing gurus thought that "white rye" would be too confusing. Whatever the reason, it is confusing and that is a shame because rye is an excellent flour. It has a totally different gluten from wheat or spelt, is high in all sorts of goodness, is a slow release carb, and an all round good sort.
The German Bakery in Windsor has a whole treatise on rye pinned up outside their door! "Dark rye" is not black or even dark brown. It's a kind of "greige" colour with flecky bits of bran it.
"dark rye" is the equivalent of whole meal (whole wheat/spelt) flour - that is to say, "dark rye" has all the bran and the germ in the flour. When you bake with dark rye, your dough will be more absorbent (ie it will need more water) and it will bake into a loaf that is slightly smaller than if you bake with light rye flour:
Just like a whole meal loaf will be slightly smaller than a white loaf, all else being equal.

description:
The lack of gluten in Arrowroot Flour (powder) makes it a perfect replacement for wheat and corn based flours. Due to it's pure starch nature, Arrowroot thickens at a lower temperature than cornstarch or conventional flour. This causes Arrowroot Flour to have a more neutral taste and very smooth consistency.

Our Arrowroot is derived from the rhizomes of the Maranta Arundinacea plant, found in Thailand. The Arrowroot itself is picked, washed, and cleaned of its undesirable scales. The roots are then reduced to a pulp using large mortars, and then dried, allowing the insoluble liquids of the root to evaporate. What's left is our pure unadulterated Anthony's Arrowroot Powder.

Wait, what's that you say? You don't have any cooking needs for our Arrowroot Powder? Well perhaps you have recently been struck by a poisonous arrow and are seeking to treat your wound. Of course you are, and no doubt you've come to the right place. As the old saying goes, "When you get hit by a poisonous arrow, goto Amazon and search for Anthony's Arrowroot Powder". I know, my mother used to say it all the time as well. It has been suggested that the name "Arrowroot" was derived by a practice of ancient Caribbean tribes that used the liquid of the root as a dressing on poison-arrow wounds, as it draws out the poison when applied to the site of the injury.

However, as common as poisonous arrow wounds have become these days, we would definitely recommend using Anthony's Arrowroot Powder primarily for baking purposes, and not so much for poisonous arrow wound purposes.

Each batch of Arrowroot Powder is tested and Batch Tested and Verified Gluten-Free.

How to Prepare the Dough
Preparing the dough is an easy process:
– Pour 2 ½ cups of water into a container.
– Add salt and gradually mix in 2 ½ cups of corn meal.
– Briefly knead the mixture until a smooth dough is formed and then let it rest for 3 minutes.

How to Prepare Arepas
Separate dough in 10 pieces. Take one portion in your hands and shape it into a ball, then press it with your palms to form a large patty shape of about 10 cm
or 3 ½ inches in diameter. Place onto a griddle or frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until brown on both sides, and serve hot.
Open the arepa and fill it with cheese, ham, eggs, salad or anything else you might put in a sandwich.

description:
Rani Juwar (Sorghum) Flour also known as jowar flour, is stone ground from 100% whole grain sorghum. It has a light color and texture and a mild, sweet flavor, making our white sorghum flour a popular alternative to wheat flour and a wonderful ingredient for gluten friendly baking.

Sorghum grains are unrelated to wheat, so they are suitable for those with celiac disease or a gluten intolerance. Traditionally, this gluten friendly flour has been used to create pancakes, porridges, beer and flatbread such as jowar roti in India. It can also substitute for other grains in cakes, cookies, breads and muffins. Due to its mild taste and smooth texture, sorghum flour is a great choice to replace wheat flour in sweet breads, cookies and more—although keep in mind you’ll need to include a binder such as xanthan gum.

Sorghum is the third most important cereal crop nationally and the fifth most important around the world. After originating in Africa thousands of years ago, the grains spread through the Middle East and Asia via ancient trade routes, traveling to the Arabian Peninsula, India and China along the Silk Road. Today, sorghum remains a staple food in India and Africa and is growing in popularity in America. In fact, the sweet sorghum used to make sorghum syrup is grown in the American South, including Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Iowa, Kentucky, Mississippi, North Carolina and Tennessee.

Increase your daily intake of whole grains the easy way: add 15% to 20% sorghum flour to your flour mixes to make delicious breads, cakes and cookies. You can also browse our extensive collection of recipes using sorghum, from monkey bread to dinner rolls!

However, as common as poisonous arrow wounds have become these days, we would definitely recommend using Anthony's Arrowroot Powder primarily for baking purposes, and not so much for poisonous arrow wound purposes.

bullet_point: [100% VEGAN FOOD THICKENER: Food To Live Organic Guar Gum is made from guar beans and is perfect for vegans., GLUTEN-FREE BAKING BINDING AGENT: Make amazing, fluffy, and tasty gluten-free baked goods using organic guar gum., DIETARY FIBER SOURCE: Organic guar gum contains so much fiber, you’ll benefit even using less than 1g of product., ORGANIC CERTIFIED: Organic Guar Gum from Food To Live contains no contaminants and is non-GMO., MULTIPLE USES: Use organic guar gum in cooking for soups, sauces, salad dressings, vegan jellies, and ice cream.]
description:
What Is Organic Guar Gum?

Organic guar gum is a product made from the seeds of the guar plant. This substance has exceptional properties as a thickener and stabilizer. Therefore, it’s used in a variety of industries, but mostly in food production.

The vast majority of processed foods contain guar gum in some form and you can use it at home to make some treats. Organic Guar Gum from Food To Live is 100% free from any contaminants and safe for you and your family to enjoy.


How Is Guar Gum Produced?

The process of organic guar gum production is rather straightforward. Guar plant beans are harvested, dehusked, milled, and screened. Organic guar gum powder is the final product. Main producers of guar gum are India, Pakistan, Australia, and the US.

Organic guar gum price is fairly low compared to the cost of some other vegan food thickeners. Its production is cheap and the demand for this substance is huge as aside from food production, it’s used in hydraulic fracturing. The latter is a method of natural gas and oil extraction that gains popularity today.


Organic Guar Gum: Benefits and Side Effects

Organic guar gum isn’t a superfood and thus doesn’t offer any specific health benefits. You’ll only need to use less than a teaspoon of the product in most recipes. Therefore, organic guar gum nutrition value doesn’t really matter.

However, you’ll definitely get a tiny boost of fiber from it as guar gum contains huge amounts of it. When consumed in reasonable amounts, organic guar gum has no side-effects. This is why it’s an approved food ingredient.

However, eating too much guar gum might cause indigestion and other digestive issues, because this product is high in fiber.
